Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (LC-MS/MS) was performed on 60 PDAC samples to establish baseline ubiquitination profiles. While the study later uses these profiles to correlate with drug resistance (gemcitabine, 5-FU, etc.) and survival, the MS analysis itself was not a perturbation study (i.e., samples were not treated with drugs prior to MS analysis, as explicitly stated: 'none of the patients from which the PDXs were derived underwent treatment prior to biopsy or tumour resection'). The drug resistance tests were performed in vivo on a subset of PDXs and are not part of the MS sample preparation.
